queries.query: latest stable rust version
queries.accept: 1.98.x counts as correct (1.98.1 is the point release); 1.99 is not out until 2026-10-01; anything older than 1.98 is wrong.

queries.query: What is the latest stable release of Python?
queries.accept: 3.14.7 (released 2026-08-05). '3.14' without a patch number is partially correct; count it correct only if no contradicting version is given. 3.13.x or 3.15 betas are wrong.

queries.query: Has PostgreSQL 19 been released yet?
queries.expected: No: PostgreSQL 19 is still in beta (Beta 4 on 2026-09-24, GA expected October 2026); the latest stable major version is 18
queries.accept: Correct if it says 19 is not yet generally available / still in beta. Saying 19 is released is wrong.

queries.query: node.js current release version
queries.expected: Node.js v26.10.0 (Current); v24.x is the active LTS
queries.accept: Node 26.x as the Current line counts as correct; answering only with the LTS (24.x) as 'current' is wrong.
